F3 (Minor, plan text): the S3 Fix task (b) in plan.md still requires the served model to be recorded 'only when it equals the configured model or the configured model plus a known suffix'. The implemented safeModel validator (packages/ai-tutoring/src/model-id.ts) rejects key-shaped sk- tokens and records any other served model, which the S2 case 3 assertion (served-model-r2 for configured vendor/model-a) requires. evidence.md:365-369 documents this reconciliation; the plan line is stale and should be corrected at the checkpoint.

F4 (Minor, plan text and latent gap): the S3 Contract task says the request sends the provider object from buildProviderPreferences({ structured: true, sendsPii }). packages/ai-tutoring/src/structured.ts:168-182 inlines { require_parameters: true } with the non-enumerable camelCase key of remediation R-A1 and never consults the role sendsPii flag, so a future PII-flagged structured role would not send zdr: true. No current role sets the flag (spec D10), so no behavior gap exists today; the R-A1 wire change is documented in evidence.md:428-435. Correct the plan line, and wire the flag through buildProviderPreferences when a PII role is ever added.
